newsitem.title: USA: C.P.Clare sees 12-month payback on Reed.
newsitem.headline: C.P.Clare sees 12-month payback on Reed.

text.p: C.P.Clare Corp Chief Financial Officer Jacqueline Arthur said the company expects to achieve a 12-month payback on its year-long restructuring of its Reed Relay products unit.

"We're looking at a 12-month period of restructuring and a 12-month payback," she told investors at a Montgomery Securities conference here, saying the action would focus and consolidate the unit's operations to work more efficiently.
C.P. Clare President and Chief Executive Arthur Buckland said the company was moving "very aggressively" to address Reed, which he called "a problem child" for the company.
